title: Пассив: being told, to be asked, to have been

theory.md: Пассив бывает и у -ing и инфинитива. **being + V3**: I hate **being told** what to do. **to be + V3**: She wants **to be asked**. **to have been + V3** — о прошлом: He is said **to have been seen** in the forest.

cells: The map seems to have been stolen.

theory.md: После глаголов вроде enjoy, avoid, hate — being + V3; после want, expect, hope — to be + V3.

examples.es: I don't like being kept waiting.
examples.ru: Не люблю, когда меня заставляют ждать.

examples.es: Everyone wants to be listened to.
The letter seems to have been opened.
He avoided being seen by the guard.
examples.ru: Он постарался, чтобы стражник его не увидел.

options: I hate being told what to do.
I hate to tell what to do.
I hate been told what to do.

exercises.ru: Никому не нравится, когда его критикуют.

exercises.statement: «I expect being paid on time» — правильно.
«He is said to have been seen» — о прошлом.
«Being asked for help is nice» — правильно.

exercises.ru: Я не люблю, когда меня перебивают.
